title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（山崎幹泰研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Yamazaki Mikihiro)
educationalGoal: Students will study historical and traditional Japanese architecture by learning about its expression and technology, social background, and the preservation of Japanese cultural heritage. Alternatively, students will design architectural works. Students will create attractive presentations with drawings, models, and computer graphics.
advice:
1. Set up a project proposal.

2. Create a project progress report.

3. Publish results.
requiredKnowledge:
Students need an interest in Japanese history, art history, archeology, folklore, etc., and must try to understand Japanese architecture and architectural culture from a broad perspective.
It is also necessary for students to improve their design ability by creating sketches and models.

activityGoals.body: Students can make an activity plan for the theme they set, and conduct research activities such as field surveys
Students can create a project report on the results of their research activities.
Students can present the contents of their project reports.
Students understand social trends in the field of architecture, and determine their own direction.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Students can make an activity plan for a theme they set and conduct research activities such as field surveys, literature surveys, and interviews.
They can create a project report (thesis or work) that fully reflects the results of their research activities.
They can present the contents of their project reports in an easy-to-understand manner.
achievementLevels.standard:
Students can conduct research activities such as field surveys, literature surveys, and interviews.
They can create a project report (thesis or work) based on the results of their research activities.
They can communicate the contents of their project reports to others.

              Students will study historical and traditional Japanese architecture by learning about its expression and technology, social background, and the preservation of Japanese cultural heritage. Alternatively, students will design architectural works. Students will create attractive presentations with drawings, models, and computer graphics.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Set up a project proposal.

2. Create a project progress report.

3. Publish results.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Students need an interest in Japanese history, art history, archeology, folklore, etc., and must try to understand Japanese architecture and architectural culture from a broad perspective.
It is also necessary for students to improve their design ability by creating sketches and models.
